Workloads are classified by **provider-qualified resource type**, not by application name or business tags. Compliance recommendations are matched to resource assessments within each subscription, then deduplicated by resource identity and assessment key so mappings to multiple controls/standards do not inflate counts.

The summary uses **all assessment states** in the selected subscription, standard, and workload scope; the state filter affects **resource detail only**. Assessed resources have at least one passed or failed assessment. A resource with any failed assessment is counted once under resources with failures. Not-applicable and unknown results are separate, not passes. High-severity findings are failed assessments only.

Recommendations without a resource assessment, and findings without an identifiable resource, remain visible in **Other/unmapped** but are excluded from resource totals. Non-Azure resources without a recognized provider-qualified type also remain in Other/unmapped.
